NEGOTIATION PROGRAM

CENTERS FOR MEDICARE & MEDICAID SERVICES

In accordance with Section 30.4 of the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: Final Guidance, Implementation
of Sections 1191 – 1198 of the Social Security Act for Initial Price Applicability Year 2028 and Manufacturer
Effectuation of the Maximum Fair Price in 2026, 2027, and 2028 (“Final Guidance”), CMS has published a list of 50
top negotiation-eligible drugs (inclusive of the 15 selected drugs) ranked by combined Total Expenditures under Part
B and Part D, information on the National Drug Code (NDC)-9s NDC-11s, and Healthcare Common Procedure Coding
System (HCPCS) codes for the negotiation-eligible drugs, as applicable.
